name: Bear In The Forest!
source:
A poor fox named Robin, got lost in the woods.  Only he was sure that he would get out of the forest, he met a big and formidable bear. What will happen to him?

[From [url=https://pot-of-cum.itch.io/bear-in-the-forest]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一只名叫罗宾的可怜的狐狸在树林里迷路了。正当他确信自己能走出森林时，他遇到了一头巨大而可怕的熊。他会发生什么事？

[来自[url=https://pot-of-cum.itch.io/bear-in-the-forest]Itch.io[/url]]
